lines.text: Two computers. One desk. A Mac... and a PC.
And one email address you type twenty times a day. Letter... by letter.
[sighs] So you keep it in a note, and copy it from there. Type it again... one letter wrong. And on a new computer? You start all over.
What if one key could just... type it for you? On every computer?
Right Shift and E... there it is. Left Shift and E? Still just a capital E. Left and right are different keys.
On your Mac, sign in and type your code once. Every shortcut is there. The only rule: sign in on each computer.
Type a short word for your whole signature. Open a link, a folder or a program with one key. And nothing you delete is ever lost.
Your shortcuts are locked with a code only you have, before they leave your computer, so nobody else can read them. And KeyBridge never records what you type.
In English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, Russian, or Arabic.
So stop typing the same things over and over. Just press it... once.
KeyBridge. Free and open source, for Mac and Windows.
